title: Local presentation of adic functions from the base pro-etale site
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the topology of an absolute value extending the $\ell$-adic absolute value [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. For a scheme $T$ let $B_T$ be the sheaf on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] whose sections on $V\to T$ are continuous functions $|V|\to\Omega$ such that each point has an open neighbourhood whose image spans a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space, with restrictions by precomposition. Let $g:Y\to X$ be any scheme morphism, $U\to Y$ an object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $s\in B_Y(U)$, and $x\in|U|$. There exist an affine open immersion $j:U_0\hookrightarrow U$ [def-weil-open-immersion] with $x\in j(|U_0|)$, an object $V\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, a section $t\in B_X(V)$, and a morphism $\phi:U_0\to V\times_XY$ over $Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product], such that $s\circ|j|=t\circ|\operatorname{pr}_V\circ\phi|$. No quasi-compactness or noetherian hypothesis is imposed on $X,Y$ or $U$.
